detail: Elected President of the Yacht Club de France at the annual general assembly on 21 May 2025, becoming the first woman to lead the institution. Non-commercial sporting/maritime club presidency.
Member of the Académie de marine, which she joined in 2024. Learned/advisory body on maritime affairs.
Joined the Institut français de la mer in 2024; reported as vice-president of the IFM. Maritime advocacy/think-tank association.

Co-founder of the association Innovations Bleues, dedicated to the sustainable development of maritime activities through eco-innovation; co-pilots the 'Voilier du Futur' (Future Sailing) project, a demonstrator of the energy and ecological transition of ships.
Co-founder (June 2015) of the Fondation de la Mer, a foundation intended to promote the maritime dimension of France.

entity: Plateforme Océan et Climat (Ocean & Climate Platform)
detail: Co-founder of the Plateforme Océan et Climat during her tenure (2010-2015) as a member of the Conseil économique, social et environnemental (CESE). Coalition of ocean-and-climate organisations.

entity: Appel pour l'Océan, bien commun de l'Humanité
detail: Co-initiated in 2018 (on World Ocean Day) the appeal 'L'Océan, bien commun de l'Humanité', aimed at raising awareness and finding solutions against marine pollution.

ownership_stake: associate (associé indéfiniment responsable); stake not disclosed
detail: Listed in the INPI/Pappers business registry as 'associé indéfiniment responsable' since 29 January 2021 of CALLISTE, a société civile immobilière (real-estate company, capital EUR 9,990) based in Beaucouzé (Pays de la Loire), her home region. Identity match on name and birth month (11/1962, French) per Pappers dirigeant record.

Per INPI/Pappers, served as liquidator of EPHESE (a SARL, 'activités des sièges sociaux / conseil de gestion') from 31 December 2019; the company has since ceased. Based in Bécon-les-Granits (Pays de la Loire). Identity match on name and birth month per Pappers dirigeant record.

Per INPI/Pappers, former representative ('ancien représentant') of SCI LORETO, a société civile immobilière in Bécon-les-Granits (Pays de la Loire), from 27 July 2016 to 12 February 2020. Identity match on name and birth month per Pappers dirigeant record.
